name: Oomine Kaede
source:
[url=/c39402]Shuuma[/url]'s junior schoolmate. Kaede calls Shuuma a brother. After his mother passed away, Kaede and her family took care of Shuuma.

Later she became friends with [url=/c34609]Mari[/url] who does all the housework for Shuuma, but Shuuma never realized they were friends.
